name: crystal_hydrate
description: Hydrate context beam from a crystal with selective shaping (tail, slice range from/to, depth, or summary only).

depth.description: Maximum traversal depth (default: 10, alias for tail)

from.description: Starting anchor or node ID/prefix for transition slice

summary_only.description: Exclude DAG transitions and hydrate living state summary only (default: false)

tail.description: Number of recent transitions to include in slice

to.description: Ending anchor or node ID/prefix for transition slice
